[P2] Correct the child-context hook timeout claim

`createPluginRunner` does not await `onOperationEnd`, including for child contexts. Its asynchronous work is drained before invocation end with the 500 ms deadline reserve, so a never-settling hook does not hold the child `EXECUTING` until Lambda times out. This contradicts the preceding migration guidance and suggests a completion guarantee plugins cannot rely on. The inline hook that can hold the child open after its function settles is `wrapChildContextFn`; name that hook here.
